اختطفوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَفُوا (iḵtaṭafū) /ix.ta.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# اُخْتُطِفُوا (uḵtuṭifū) /ux.tu.tˤi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# اِخْتَطِفُوا (iḵtaṭifū) /ix.ta.tˤi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
